correctness.rationale: The exact separated identity gives \(G_\alpha(Y_{\alpha,p})=C\tau\alpha^{1-p}\). The pointwise integrand bound follows from \(u/(1+u)\le1-e^{-u}\le u\), yielding the non-asymptotic inverse bracket and the three time regimes. For the first correction, \(q(u)=1/(1-e^{-u})-1/u\) satisfies \(0\le q\le1\) and \(q(u)\to1/2\), so dominated convergence gives \((G_\alpha-L)/\alpha\to y/2\) uniformly in the stated potential sense; the mean-value theorem then yields the critical-scale state correction uniformly away from \(\tau=0\). Boundary claims are explicitly limited: the \(p>1\) limit is not uniform at \(\tau=0\), and no first-order state expansion through \(\tau=0\) is claimed.
